mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 metabolism of armodafinil, potentially increasing armodafinil plasma concentrations, while both agents have mild antiplatelet effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased armodafinil side effects (insomnia, headache, anxiety); counsel patient on bleeding precautions; consider dose adjustment if CNS effects emerge.
